morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词根记忆，不拆成 per-、maid 或 -ani；per 中的 e 为 /ə/，mai 含双元音 /ai̯/。

word_family.gloss: 多张或各式地毯；全词重叠形式

senses.zh_definition: 铺在地板上的厚织物，常由羊毛等材料制成，可带有彩色花纹；地毯。
senses.en_definition: A carpet or rug, typically made of wool or other textile fibres and used as a floor covering.
senses.ms_definition: Hamparan daripada bulu domba dan sebagainya, lazimnya berwarna-warni; ambal.
senses.nuances: 可指整片地毯或独立铺设的小地毯，不限于羊毛材质。常用量词 sebidang；不与祈祷垫 sejadah 完全等同。[DBP：permaidani](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=permaidani)

dual_scenarios.ms: Petugas telah menghamparkan permaidani merah di pintu masuk dewan bagi menyambut tetamu kehormat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 工作人员已在礼堂入口铺上红地毯，迎接贵宾。
dual_scenarios.en: Staff have laid out a red carpet at the hall entrance to welcome the guest of honour.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Permaidani kat ruang tamu tu dah kotor, kena cuci lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Permaidani di ruang tamu itu sudah kotor dan perlu dicuci.
dual_scenarios.zh: 客厅那张地毯已经脏了，得洗一洗啦。
dual_scenarios.en: The living room carpet's dirty now. It needs a wash.
spoken_features: kena 在此表示需要，lah 增添熟悉的口语语气

messages.speaker: Farah (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Permaidani kat ruang tamu tu dah kotor. Nak hantar cuci tak?
messages.ms_standard: Permaidani di ruang tamu itu sudah kotor. Mahukah kita menghantarnya untuk dicuci?
messages.zh: 客厅那张地毯已经脏了，要不要送去洗？
messages.en: The living room carpet's dirty. Shall we send it out for cleaning?

messages.speaker: Amir (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh, esok aku hantar. Gulung dulu je malam ni.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh, saya akan menghantarnya esok. Kita gulungkannya dahulu malam ini.
messages.zh: 可以，我明天送去。今晚先卷起来就行。
messages.en: Sure, I'll take it tomorrow. Let's just roll it up tonight.

etymology.historical_story: Permaidani has been linked to Malayalam paravatāni, ‘carpet’, with related forms in Javanese and Indonesian. This connection places an everyday furnishing word within the wider history of contact between South India and maritime Southeast Asia. The precise transmission route deserves caution; synchronically, Malay speakers use the whole word rather than assembling it from productive affixes. [Etymological overview](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/permaidani)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 per—mai—da—ni 四拍读，想象四拍把整张地毯铺开；整词记住“地毯”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 进入铺有地毯的私人住宅时，留意主人是否要求脱鞋，可礼貌询问 Perlu buka kasut?
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于家居、酒店、会场及接待场景。permaidani merah 可让人联想到贵宾礼遇；涉及礼拜用品时，具体的祈祷垫通常称 sejadah。
